training.description: Model training stage - validates model learns meaningful patterns

ic.description: Information Coefficient - measures prediction-target correlation (industry minimum: 0.01-0.03)

ic_ir.description: IC Information Ratio - IC stability over time (industry minimum: 0.3-0.5)

backtest.description: Backtesting stage - evaluates strategy performance on historical data

sharpe_ratio.description: Risk-adjusted returns (crypto targets: 1.0-2.0 for viable strategies, >2.5 for excellent)

win_rate.description: Percentage of profitable trades (40-55% typical for momentum strategies)

calmar_ratio.description: Return/Max Drawdown ratio (>1.0 indicates returns exceed worst losses)

information_ratio.description: Alpha/tracking error vs benchmark (>0.5 shows consistent outperformance)

max_drawdown.reason: More room for drawdowns in bull markets

prediction.description: Live prediction stage - ensures model generates usable forecasts

coverage.description: Minimum 80% of symbols should have predictions

prediction_std.description: Predictions should show meaningful variation without being erratic

prediction_mean.description: Predictions should be centered around zero (no systematic bias)

_metadata.methodology: Industry-standard baselines for crypto trading strategies. Targets derived from academic literature, practitioner reports, and crypto market characteristics.
sources: Crypto Trading Strategies (Alipour et al., 2022) - Drawdown tolerances
Industry practice: 50+ backtests recommended for statistical validation
_metadata.regime_detection: Regimes determined by 60-day moving average: Bull (price > MA + 5%), Bear (price < MA - 5%), Sideways (between)
next_steps: Run 50+ backtests across different market periods
Adjust targets based on actual distributions
Separate targets by asset volatility class (BTC, ETH, altcoins)
Validate regime adjustments with historical data
